parameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE newly drawn complete game animation sprite, character 08 alchemy prodigy boy. Reference 1 is original identity; reference 2 is painted material/style only, do not draw its UI; reference 3 is the approved-for-proportion SOUTH idle candidate, same exact head/body ratio, costume and equipment. Preserve chestnut straight locks and topknot jade-gold clasp with two gold ribbons, round little boy face and amber eyes, orange-gold brocade coat, ivory wide cuffs/trousers, teal-gold panels, yin-yang belt buckle, jade boots with ivory toecaps. Anatomical RIGHT hand supports bronze/jade yin-yang censer upright; LEFT hand holds teal potion vial. Medicine backpack contains two ivory scroll tubes, herbs, brown yin-yang pouch and red/gold tassel; maintain fixed sides and realistic occlusion. High-detail bright clean rounded hand-painted Daoist chibi, short-limbed 2.5-head proportions. No redesign or plastic 3D. Camera fixed slight top-down RPG, character walking in place with stable torso/ground origin, face and body and feet aligned to direction. Arms carefully hold equipment so swing is small, coat hems/straps follow leg movement slightly. True transparent alpha, no floor/shadow/background/checkerboard/text/VFX. Single character on square native canvas at least 1024x1024, whole silhouette about 84% canvas height, head/hair/ribbons/feet fully inside safe margin. Body centered x50%, planted sole y92%. Clean antialiased edges without magenta/red/yellow fringe. Do not copy/mirror/warp/translate a prior pose; redraw actual changed leg articulation, weight support and cloth for this exact phase. One image only, not a sprite sheet. DIRECTION SOUTH, front view, moving directly toward viewer. Anatomical left leg is on the viewer's right; forward boot appears lower in the image. Gait phase 01/16, left foot forward heel contact, right foot behind on its toe starting push-off; legs clearly separated front to back, left knee almost straight, right knee slightly flexed. Head at neutral height.
